transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or how you're getting on with your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. 

However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month, so keep the gardening gentle to start with.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds good. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel or drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

So you should be fine to carry on with it. If you're not sure about your specific situation though, it's best to check with your care team to be certain.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense. I also wanted to ask, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further. 

Are you experiencing mild sensitivity, or is it more severe with pain and redness?

If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

How long ago was your surgery?

Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help. Take care, and remember to follow the advice we've discussed. All the best with your recovery!
